body.name: published nominal-label estimator and efficient nominal subexperiment
body.construction: Han--Owusu--Shin Appendix-B Eq. (S1) is the Horvitz--Thompson estimator \(\widehat U^{HOS}_{C,k}=(Cp_k)^{-1}\sum_c\mathbf 1\{L_c=k\}[\gamma_k(Z_c)/\beta_k(Z_c)]W_c(Z_c)\). The best regular nominal-label procedure calibrates assignment cells using only \(\{L_c=k,Z_c\in\mathcal S_k\}\) and has canonical gradient \(\phi_k^{nom}\).
